revises the failed move until the change is shown.One Internal illustration. Generators in this paper include Wan
TI2V-5B, Wan T2V-A14B, and MiniMax-H3
(Sections6andC).
(a) Setup and leak check the first two shots; reveal and inside split
the last shot into the factors of Eq. (1). The raw take
opens the tin onto another object.
(b) Diagnose the last frame, revise the move rather than the answer,
and generate again with the same model. The rewrite puts in the orange
marble and opens to it; the original stays a candidate.
